✶The Ledger✶

3,500+
Plus more than 230 hospitalizations for the week ending Oct. 17. The state has declared flu prevalent, earlier than usual, WKBW reports.

✶The National Wire✶

1

Brewers Win It All

Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay 4–1 in Game 5 Wednesday night to win the World Series, the first championship in the franchise's history, CBS reports. The Brewers took the series four games to one.

2

Update: Spain's Toll Rises to 68

At least 68 people died and dozens were hurt when one high-speed train hit the back of another in central Spain Wednesday, CBS reports. The BBC has released audio of exchanges between the control center and the drivers before the crash; it is Spain's second major train crash this year.

3

DoorDash Buys Instacart

DoorDash said this morning it will buy Instacart for $17 billion, or $65 a share, joining the biggest names in restaurant and grocery delivery, CBS reports. DoorDash says more supermarkets will be able to use Instacart's tools to run their own websites.

☑ The Ballot · 5 days to Election Day · every race: benthambulletin.github.io/election
Vote early Early voting is open now, through Nov. 1 (4 days left).
Governor Hochul (D) is ahead of Blakeman (R) by about 13 points.
Washington Democrats are favored to take the House. The Senate is close, tilting Democratic.
Our House seats NY-26 (North Tonawanda): Kennedy (D, inc.) vs Hannon (R). Cook rates it Solid D. NY-23 (Orchard Park, Dunkirk, Fredonia): Langworthy (R, inc.) vs Gies (D). NY-25 (Scottsville): Morelle (D, inc.) vs McIntyre (R).

⛪The Home Wire⛪

1

Lockport · Atomic-Era Mill Cleanup Gets Its Contractor

The Army Corps of Engineers awarded a $249 million contract to Sevenson Environmental to clean up the old Guterl Specialty Steel site off Ohio Street, the Niagara Gazette reports. Nine buildings in the former Simonds Saw & Steel complex handled uranium for the atomic program after World War II; work is expected to start next year.

2

Fredonia · Volleyball Rolls On

Fredonia's girls beat Salamanca Wednesday in the Section VI Class B2 volleyball quarterfinals at Fredonia High, the Observer reports. Coach Amanda Krakowiak called a timeout with the first set tied 20–20 to reset her team.

★The Marquee★

1

Paddington Stays in London

Paddington the Musical has extended its West End run through June 2028, Variety reports. It tied the record with seven Olivier Awards this year and nears its first anniversary at the Savoy Theatre.

2

U2, Up Close

U2 will play a small, invitation-only show for BBC Music in central London on Nov. 3, Billboard reports. The set mixes classics with songs from the coming album Carnaval de Luz and airs on BBC Two later in November.

3

Prada Goes Hand-Drawn

Prada's new holiday campaign starring Sadie Sink and Maya Hawke was drawn by hand by veteran Disney animator John Pomeroy, Variety reports. It has drawn wide praise online since its debut Wednesday night, at a time when AI is everywhere in advertising.

Jets · The Jets are 1–2 at MetLife this season, their home win a 17–12 decision over Cleveland on Oct. 11. They get the Raiders there Sunday at 1:00.
